config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(minute_start) AS ts, platform AS group_key, round(sum(active_ms) / ($__interval_s * 1000.0), 2) AS avg_concurrent FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'all dimensions' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY ts, group_key ORDER BY ts

SELECT platform AS group_key, round(sum(active_ms) / 3600000.0, 2) AS viewer_hours, round(100.0 * sum(active_ms) / nullIf((SELECT sum(active_ms) FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'all dimensions' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters), 0), 2) AS share_pct, sum(sessions_started) AS intervals_started FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'all dimensions' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY group_key ORDER BY viewer_hours DESC

config.markdown:
Every tab reads the `all dimensions` slice and changes only the `GROUP BY`, so the filters compose with any grouping.

Bars plot `sum(active_ms) / bucket` — time-weighted average concurrent viewers. `active_ms` is additive, so a stack sums to the true total: verified at 855.603469 grouped by platform, identical to the ungrouped figure, with shares summing to 100.00. The `other` bucket keeps the Title and Category stacks exact rather than dropping the long tail.

No peak here. Two platforms reach their maxima at different instants, so stacked peaks would exceed the true 2,305. Exact peaks are on *Concurrency analytics*.

`share_pct` is a share of viewing time, not of viewers.
